analysis.executive_summary: Audit of docs.saleor.io crawled 2,173 pages with 100% coverage across a single-product documentation site. Only 2 confirmed broken internal links were found, both within user-facing documentation. API reference coverage is low at 35.29% despite detecting 1,962 API pages. SEO/metadata issues affect 22.1% of pages, and freshness metadata is nearly absent with only 0.78% of pages displaying last-updated timestamps. Example code reliability is estimated at 85.95%, and overall audit confidence stands at 78.17%.
strengths: Complete crawl coverage at 100% with 2,173 pages successfully examined
Minimal broken links with only 2 confirmed broken internal documentation links
No broken repository navigation links detected
High example code reliability estimate at 85.95%
Large API surface detected with 1,962 API-related pages identified
risks: API reference coverage critically low at 35.29%, indicating poor integration between API docs and usage examples
SEO/metadata issues present on 22.1% of pages (481 pages), impacting discoverability and search ranking
Freshness metadata virtually absent with only 0.78% coverage, preventing users from assessing content currency
1 link could not be verified due to authentication, rate-limiting, or server blocks, creating uncertainty
Overall audit confidence at 78.17% suggests moderate reliability gaps in findings
Link verification confidence at 61.67% is notably low, indicating potential false negatives in link health
78 URLs skipped as crawler traps may hide additional documentation quality issues

prioritized_actions.action: Implement last-updated timestamps across all documentation pages to address 0.78% freshness coverage
Audit and expand API usage documentation to improve 35.29% reference coverage across 1,962 API pages
Remediate SEO/metadata issues affecting 22.1% of pages (481 pages) to improve discoverability
Fix 2 confirmed broken internal documentation links and investigate 1 unverified link
Review and validate 78 crawler-trap URLs to ensure no legitimate documentation is excluded

limitations: External audit cannot verify content accuracy, technical correctness, or whether documentation matches actual product behavior
Link verification confidence of 61.67% means some broken links may be undetected or false positives may exist; 1 link remains unverified due to access restrictions
API coverage detection relies on heuristics and may not capture all integration gaps or measure documentation quality and completeness
Crawler trap detection (78 URLs skipped) may exclude valid pages or miss problematic infinite-loop patterns
Example code reliability estimate does not guarantee executability, version compatibility, or real-world applicability of code samples
